short: Local-first personal finance CLI and TUI
example:
fui init --currency EUR
  fui add -12,50 Esselunga -c Groceries -a Checking
  fui account list --json

flags.name: db
flags.usage: path to the archive (default: XDG data dir)

flags.name: dry-run
flags.usage: show the plan of a write without applying it

flags.name: json
flags.usage: output as JSON (snake_case, amounts in minor units)

flags.name: no-input
flags.usage: never prompt; fail with missing_field instead

flags.name: yes
flags.usage: confirm a bulk write or an agent-mode write

commands.short: Add, list, show, edit or archive accounts

commands.example: fui account add Checking --kind checking --currency EUR --opening-balance 1000

flags.name: kind
flags.usage: cash, checking, credit_card, savings, investment or loan

flags.name: opened-on
flags.usage: date the account was opened (default: today)

commands.example:
fui add -12,50 Esselunga -c Groceries -a Checking
  fui add -- -12,50 Cash withdrawal -a Checking

commands.short: Write a backup of the archive
Add, list, rename, merge or remove categories

flags.name: reassign-to
flags.usage: category to move existing transactions to

commands.example:
fui completion bash > /etc/bash_completion.d/fui
  fui completion zsh > "${fpath[1]}/_fui"

commands.short: List, show or test import connectors
Show the metadata of one connector
Fetch and validate a connector stream without importing it
commands.example: fui connector test csv statement.csv --profile mybank

flags.name: account
flags.usage: connector account ref or name (csv connector)

flags.name: since
flags.usage: only fetch records on or after this date

commands.short: Export transactions, or the full archive with --all
commands.example:
fui export --account Checking --format csv --output checking.csv
  fui export --all --output ./dump

flags.name: after-date
flags.usage: resume after this ISO date (from the previous page)

flags.name: after-id
flags.usage: resume after this transaction id (from the previous page)

flags.name: all
flags.usage: dump the full archive into --output, one file per entity

flags.name: format
flags.usage: csv, json or fui (fui only without --all)

flags.name: output
flags.usage: output file (export) or directory (--all); stdout when omitted

flags.name: text
flags.usage: case-insensitive substring of description or notes

commands.short: Set or list manual exchange rates

flags.name: date
flags.usage: date the rate applies from (default: today)

commands.example:
fui import statement.csv --connector csv --profile mybank --account Checking
  fui import export.fui.jsonl

flags.name: account
flags.usage: connector account ref or name (csv connector)

flags.name: create-accounts
flags.usage: create accounts for refs still unmapped

flags.name: map
flags.usage: bind a connector ref to an account: ref=account (repeatable)

flags.name: since
flags.usage: only fetch records on or after this date

flags.name: currency
flags.usage: set the base currency (ISO 4217), e.g. EUR

commands.short: Compute the runway KPI (months of liquidity left at current spending)

flags.name: at
flags.usage: evaluate as of this date (default: today)

commands.short: Run a predefined report (categories or cashflow)

flags.name: month
flags.usage: report this single accounting month, e.g. 2026-10

commands.short: Restore the archive from a backup
Show or install the agent skill
Install the agent skill into a skills directory

flags.name: dest-amount
flags.usage: amount arriving, when the accounts differ in currency

flags.name: fee
flags.usage: fee charged on the source account
